business_summary: Curtiss-Wright Corporation (NYSE: CW, CIK 26324) is a diversified US aerospace-defense and industrial manufacturer. It sits on the humanoid-actuators chain's roller-screws link (Planetary roller screws & linear guides; heat verdict EMERGING; not money-corner) through its Exlar brand's FT Series planetary-roller-screw linear actuators. SEC companyfacts gives revenue, operating income, cash flow and capex cleanly through FY2025 (calendar fiscal year); FY2025 revenue was $3.4984 billion.
